[SWS_DM_01081] Session check for sourceDataIdentifier
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04246, RS_Diag_04226
⌈
On reception of service ’DynamicallyDefineDataIdentifier’ with subfunction de-
fineByIdentifier and if
DiagnosticDynamicallyDefineDataIdentifierClass.
checkPerSourceId
is set to true, the DM shall check if the sourceDataIdentifier
can be defined in the current session according to [SWS_DM_00413]. If any source-
DataIdentifier cannot be defined in the current session, the DM shall return an NRC
0x31 (
kRequestOutOfRange
).
⌋
